description: Holistic design synthesis from the lifecycle map, M2, M4, corpus and earlier papers. PLAN.md M5.
notes:
Design-draft errata from G10: §5.2.1 'lines need no interior samples' is wrong on ruled/twisted faces; healing §7.2 'edge shorter than 4β' clause is redundant (arc length) or wrong (chord); split β into the R2 repair threshold and a separate collapse radius r_c (changes the arena thresholds flag).
G14: design §6.1 lacks a per-span principal-curvature bound for rational B-splines, needed by any freeform angle term; no source gives one (paper §6 names the work and oracle). Grading conflicts with sharpen-in-place and incremental remeshing.
G16: add a sample-count floor (closed edge >= 3 segments; among edges sharing both end vertices at most one single segment), since the draft can emit duplicate mesh edges on one vertex pair (breaks Shephard classification and the 3MF manifold rule). Add an 'absorbed' face outcome. Identity carried as face-contiguous ranges, off the hot path.
G2: chain policy = settle and protect a sufficient chain (P1-P4 predicates, hereditary, order-independent, geometry-derived stop via Ruppert/Shewchuk packing over Pav-Walkington lfs); coupled queue only as an arena arm. Requirement on M2's L3 blend: weights from the curve parameter, not the polyline, so inserting a sample moves no other sample. Corrects the healing paper's stop rule (lens width ~l^2 kappa vs separation, not segment length).
G7: determinism classes D0 (decode, byte-identical everywhere), D1-shared (carrier, planning, vertices, edge chains: one producer per entity by content key), D1 (faces, records), D2 (publication, export, digests), D3 (timings, provisional; never keyed). Backend = build digest + actual arithmetic incl. libm variant (glibc swaps FMA asin/acos/sin/cos on AVX2+FMA hosts) -> own transcendentals. Cache key over dependency OUTPUT digests (early cutoff, no cracks). Draft determinism wording contradicts D-determinism (paper §8). Round-CAD-number ties at integer sample counts: optional ceil(x(1+2^-40)) arena arm.
G15: PMI inputs with trustworthy units run only at absolute eps requests (relative 1e-3 diag violates tolerances on all 17 NIST PMI models, worst 84x). 11 NIST hole sizes have nominal on the lower limit: any vertices-on-surface mesh is out of tolerance; report PMI-OUT. Declared uncertainty reflects the exporter (1e-6 to 0.127 mm), not the part. Senders declare gaps larger than G = min(4eps, lfs/4) legal (FTC-07 0.127 mm vs G = 0.02 mm); needs edge measurement H5.
G13: Rule A cap = circumradius > 2x smallest enclosing radius AND flat-normal error > sqrt(2 eps kappa), repaired by interior points only, goal-unmet if unrepairable. Rule B: each face corner gets its own exact normal, never averaged; edge classification is measured (STEP stores no regularity; draft §5.2 item 6 and §4.7 'G1 edges share a normal' are wrong). Rule C: glTF float32 normals per corner per face; STL facet normal from rounded winding. Specify freeform collapsed-edge limit normals (native/om10/math.hpp:126,151 refuse today).
G9: NVIDIA accounting = per mesh key (definition, scale class), NVIDIA given one definition-frame .brep per key with chord eps/sigma_max; emit stage timed separately through the same owned emitter; report definition/key/occurrence counts per placement kind. G17's per-face tolerance minimum must run within one scale class. tau = 1e-6 admit/refuse.
G4: §5.6 becomes 'clearance budgets in construction' (proposed text in paper §7): half-clearance lemma; per-face localization eps_hat <= 2eps + s_e plus repair displacement mu; NEW shared-edge tilt rule (first-row triangles tilt < 0.5 sin(min wedge opening), graded band beyond); vertex cone rule; UV half-clearance. Budgets never split between faces (tightening one face made crossings worse). Thin walls wider than eps meshed at eps_loc = w/2, never refused (D-features). Counterexamples on the draft's cylinder slab rule: 59/2016 thick crescents cross.
title: M5: rewrite FAST_MESHER_DESIGN.md whole
